name: cool-mode
title: Cool Mode
description: Sprays playful particles — circles, images or emoji — from the pointer while you press the wrapped element.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapping span (any other span attribute is forwarded too).

props.name: options
props.description: { particle?, size?, particleCount?, speedHorz?, speedUp? } — see below. Changing their values restarts the effect.

props.name: options.particle
props.description: "circle" for random-coloured dots, an image URL (http… or /…), or any text or emoji.

props.name: children
props.description: The element that emits particles while pressed (usually a button).
